verse_text_english: In the name of God, Most Gracious,
O you hidden secret.*
verse_footnote_english: *74:1 God’s infinite wisdom willed to reveal the Quran through Muhammad, while the Quran’s awesome 19-based mathematical miracle was revealed through God’s Mes­ senger of the Covenant 1406 lunar years after revelation of the Quran (1406=19x74 & 1974 AD was the Solar Year of discovery). In retrospect, we realize that the whole sura refers to the Quran’s 19-based miracle (Appendices 1 & 2).

verse_text_english: Come out and warn.
Extol your Lord.
Purify your garment.*
Forsake what is wrong.
Be content with your lot.
Steadfastly commemorate your Lord.
Then, when the horn is blown.
That will be a difficult day.
For the disbelievers, not easy.
Let Me deal with one I created as an individual.
I provided him with lots of money.
And children to behold.
I made everything easy for him.
Yet, he is greedy for more.
He stubbornly refused to accept these proofs.
I will increasingly punish him.
For he reflected, then decided.
Miserable is what he decided.
Miserable indeed is what he decided. 26.1 will commit him to retribution.
He looked.
He frowned and whined.
Then he turned away arrogantly.
He said, “This is but clever magic!
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'thar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال إن هذا إلا سحر يؤثر

verse_text_english: “This is human made.”
I will commit him to retribution.
What retribution!
Thorough and comprehensive.
Obvious to all the people.
Over it is nineteen.*
verse_footnote_english: *74:30-35 This “One of the great miracles” provides the first physical evidence that the Quran is God’s message to the world. This 19-based miracle is detailed in Appendix 1. 2 2671 The Hidden Secret 74:48-56 & Resurrection (Al-Qeyaamah) 75:1-19 r 577

verse_text_english: We appointed angels to be guardians nf Hell. and we assigned their number (19 (1) to disturb the disbelievers, (2) to convince the Christians and (3) to strengthen the faith of the faithful, (4) to remove all traces of doubt from the hearts of Christians, (5) to expose those who harbor doubt in their hearts, and the disbelievers; they will say, “What did GOD mean by this allegory?” GOD thus sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills. soldiers of your Lord except He. This is a reminder for the people.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

verse_text_arabic_clean: وما جعلنا أصحب النار إلا ملئكة وما جعلنا عدتهم إلا فتنة للذين كفروا ليستيقن الذين أوتوا الكتب ويزداد الذين ءامنوا إيمنا ولا يرتاب الذين أوتوا الكتب والمؤمنون وليقول الذين فى قلوبهم مرض والكفرون ماذا أراد الله بهذا مثلا كذلك يضل الله من يشاء ويهدى من يشاء وما يعلم جنود ربك إلا هو وما هى إلا ذكرى للبشر

verse_text_english: Absolutely, (I swear) by the moon.
And the night as it passes.
And the morning as it shines.
This is one of the great miracles.*
A warning to the human race.
For those among you who wish to advance, or regress.
verse_text_arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
verse_text_transliterated: liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhar
verse_text_arabic_clean: لمن شاء منكم أن يتقدم أو يتأخر

verse_text_english: Every soul is trapped by its sins.
Except for those on the right.
While in Paradise, they will ask.
About the guilty.
“What brought you to this retribution?”
They will say, “We did not observe the contact prayers (Salat).
“We did not feed the poor.
“We blundered with the blunderers.
“We disbelieved in the Day of Judgment.
“Until certainty came to us now.”
The intercession of the intercessors will never help them.
Why are they so averse to this reminder?
Running like zebras.
Who are fleeing from the lion!
Does each one of them want to receive the scripture personally?
verse_text_arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
verse_text_transliterated: bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharata
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل يريد كل امرئ منهم أن يؤتى صحفا منشرة

verse_text_english: Indeed, they do not fear the Hereafter.
Indeed, this is a reminder.
For those who wish to take heed.
They cannot take heed against GOD’s will. He is the source of righteousness; He is the source of forgiveness.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirat
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما يذكرون إلا أن يشاء الله هو أهل التقوى وأهل المغفرة
